document_api_meta.title: Get Product SKPP Detail
document_api_meta.env_desc: Return the SKPP qualification status, current and target scores, task progress and suggested actions, reward eligibility and status, and offline snapshot time for one product. This API is available only to sellers authorized for SKPP in the US market.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: locale
request_query_param.desc:
The BCP-47 locale codes for displaying category information.
Default: The default locale of your shop.
Possible values:
- en
- en-GB
- zh-CN
- de-DE
- id-ID
- it-IT
- ja-JP
- ms-MY
- pt-BR
- th-TH
- vi-VN

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: request_id
response_param.desc: Request log

response_param.name: data
response_param.desc: Specific return information

response_param.name: ^product_id
response_param.desc: Platform product ID.

response_param.name: ^affiliate_program_status
response_param.desc: Affiliate Program enrolment. Possible values: ACTIVE / INACTIVE.

response_param.name: ^total_score
response_param.desc: Current SKPP total score, as of update_time.

response_param.name: ^target_score
response_param.desc: Score threshold to qualify for SKPP.

response_param.name: ^rewards
response_param.desc: Reward list.

response_param.name: ^^reward_type
response_param.desc: Possible values: ADS_CREDIT / TOP_CREATOR_MATCHMAKING / SHOPTAB_PV / BIG_PROMOTION_CAMPAIGN / OFF_PLATFORM_BESTSELLER_ADS_CREDIT.

response_param.name: ^^title
response_param.desc: Localized reward name, resolved from the shared Seller-Center content by the request locale.

response_param.name: ^^status
response_param.desc: Possible values: NOT_GRANTED / PENDING / AVAILABLE

response_param.name: ^^ad_credit_claim_status
response_param.desc: Ad-credit-only sub-status, returned only when reward_type = ADS_CREDIT and status = AVAILABLE. Possible values: UNCLAIMED (eligible, not yet claimed) / CLAIMED (claimed).

response_param.name: ^^value
response_param.desc: Granted amount/quantity; currency-typed values lead with the currency symbol.

response_param.name: ^^claim_conditions
response_param.desc: Thresholds to unlock the reward; used by ADS_CREDIT.

response_param.name: ^^^condition_type
response_param.desc: Possible values: GMV / ORDER.

response_param.name: ^^^current_value
response_param.desc: Current progress; GMV-typed values lead with the currency symbol.

response_param.name: ^^^target_value
response_param.desc: Threshold value; same formatting as current_value.

response_param.name: ^^campaign_id
response_param.desc: Returned only for reward_type = BIG_PROMOTION_CAMPAIGN.

response_param.name: ^task_details
response_param.desc: Per-category score breakdown with suggested actions.

response_param.name: ^^category
response_param.desc:
Key for the scoring category.
Possible values:
- COMMISSION_RATE
- FULFILMENT
- PRICING
- FREE_SHIPING
- FOLLOWER_BENEFITS
- SAMPLING
- ADS_SPEND
- STOCK
- SHOPPABLE_VIDEOS
- INFORMATION_QUALITY
- CRM_HOSTING

response_param.name: ^^name
response_param.desc: Localized category name, resolved from category via the shared content by the request locale.

response_param.name: ^^current_value
response_param.desc: Current value of this dimension's metric (e.g. current price, commission rate, free-shipping status).

response_param.name: ^^target_value
response_param.desc: The threshold this dimension must reach to pass. It uses the same unit as `current_value` and may include a leading comparison operator, such as `≥` or `≤`, to show the required direction.

response_param.name: ^^passed
response_param.desc: Whether this dimension meets its target_value.

response_param.name: ^^action_suggestions
response_param.desc: Suggested actions to complete this task; returned only when passed = false. A task may have multiple suggestions.

response_param.name: ^^^score_increase
response_param.desc: SKPP points added to total_score when this action is completed; for tiered actions, the maximum tier.

response_param.name: ^^^url
response_param.desc: Link to the Seller Center page that completes the action.

response_param.name: ^update_time
response_param.desc: Date of the offline data snapshot that total_score, rewards and the score breakdown are derived from, returned as a Unix timestamp in seconds, pinned to the last second of that date in UTC (23:59:59Z). The value is date-level only — the time component is always 23:59:59 UTC — because the SKPP scoring runs in an offline pipeline with no intraday granularity. Latency is typically T+1 (the evening of day N publishes the day N−1 snapshot) and at most T+2.

response_param.name: ^skpp_status
response_param.desc: Possible values: QUALIFIED / NOT_QUALIFIED / NOT_ELIGIBLE.
